data.name: Ahbab
data.gender_notes: Ahbab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahbab is a term used in the Quran to refer to the beloved friends and companions of the Prophet Muhammad. It symbolizes a strong bond of love and friendship. The name Ahbab carries the meaning “Beloved Friends” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahbab usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved friends and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ahbab represents the spiritual connection between the Prophet and his companions, exemplifying loyalty, trust, and devotion.
data.etymology: Ahbab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved Friends.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahbab total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: احباب
in_arabic.meaning: أحباب الله من عباده و هو محبة الله لعباده
in_arabic.long_meaning: أحباب الله من عباده و هو محبة الله لعباده بلا حدود أو قيود، و هو حب الله لعباده حتى يرزقهم من نوره و يهديهم إلى سبيله، و هو حب الله لعباده حتى يرزقهم من رزقه و يرزقهم من عطائه، و هو حب الله لعباده حتى يرزقهم من رحمته و يرزقهم من ملكه

in_urdu.name: احباب
in_urdu.meaning: احباب اللہ ان کے عباد ہیں جو اللہ کے لئے محبت کرتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: احباب اللہ ان کے عباد ہیں جو اللہ کے لئے محبت کرتے ہیں، اس کا مطلب یہ ہے کہ ان کے دل میں اللہ کا حب ہوتا ہے، اللہ ان کے لئے رحمت اور مغفرت کا ذریعہ ہوتا ہے، اللہ ان کے لئے رزق کا ذریعہ ہوتا ہے، اللہ ان کے لئے عطاء کا ذریعہ ہوتا ہے، اللہ ان کے لئے رحمت کا ذریعہ ہوتا ہے

data.cultural_impact: The term Ahbab holds an important place in Islamic history as it represents the closeness and significance of the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during his lifetime. This name serves as a reminder of the importance of companionship, loyalty, and love towards the Prophet and his teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the term Ahbab signifies the strong bond and love between the believer and God (Allah). It is a reminder of the angels being the beloved friends of Allah, who are any believer's constant companions in their spiritual journey towards attaining closeness to Allah. This spiritual significance serves as a motivation for Muslims to strive for a strong bond and love with their Creator and to emulate the virtues and qualities of the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in their daily lives.
